newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldova 96 Jan-Nov foreign trade gap up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Moldova 96 Jan-Nov foreign trade gap up sharply.

text.p: Moldova's foreign trade deficit widened to $250 million in January-November of 1996 from $85 million in the same period of 1995, an official from the State Statistics Department told Reuters.
Moldova imported goods worth $961 million in the first eleven months of 1996. Exports were $711 million.
Note: figures are in millions of dollars.
Russia accounted for 38 percent of all Moldova's foreign trade operations, followed by Ukraine with 18 percent, Romania with eight percent, Germany and Belarus with five percent each.
